origin.osdi: OpenVAF/OSDI external Verilog-A compact model support in ngspice

primary_elements.name: VCVS
primary_elements.netlist_template: E<name> n+ n- nc+ nc- <gain|behavioral form>

primary_elements.name: VCCS
primary_elements.netlist_template: G<name> n+ n- nc+ nc- <gm|behavioral form>

primary_elements.name: Digital primitive in PSPICE compatibility mode

cad_generation_rules: If designator is A, generate symbol from model keyword metadata (xspice_models)
If ports is model_defined, require explicit pin-map entry in component instance
For vector ports, support bus pins and width parameters
For F/H/W/K, support non-pin control/reference links in netlist metadata
Treat U designator as disambiguated by context (URC vs digital primitive)

legacy_y_type.migration_note: Prefer U-type syntax for new libraries.

cad_generation_rules: Use designator-specific symbol templates for B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/L/M/O/P/Q/R/S/T/V/W/Z
For K/F/H/W, store control/reference links in metadata, not as physical pins
For U, Y<type>, X, YPDE and P, use parameterized/auto-generated pin maps
Treat Y<type> as import-compatible but deprecated; prefer U for emission
Keep model level metadata separate from symbol topology for M, Q, D

ngspice.name: Digital primitive in PSPICE compatibility mode

notes: Designators may have simulator-specific semantics (e.g. U, Y*).
Use per_simulator manifests as source of truth for symbol generation.
Use crosswalk for portability checks and import/export mapping.
